description: This Java class, DatabaseUserDetailsService, implements Spring Security's UserDetailsService interface to load user details from a database using UserRepository. It fetches user data by email and maps it to UserDetails object for authentication purposes.

classes.name: DatabaseUserDetailsService
classes.description: Service class implementing UserDetailsService to fetch user details from database using UserRepository and mapping with UserDetailsMapper.

methods.name: loadUserByUsername
methods.description: Loads user details by username (email) from the database, throws UsernameNotFoundException if user not found.
